description: How accurate each election forecaster, model, prediction market and pollster has been on resolved races, adjusted for how hard each race was. Use this to answer 'whose election forecast should I trust'. Difficulty adjustment matters: on raw scores whoever rated the safest races wins.

limit.description: How many ranked entries to return, best first. Default 10.

office.description: Restrict the board to one office, or ALL for every resolved race.

name: forecaster_accuracy

adjusted_for_difficulty.description: True. Raw scores reward whoever rated the safest races, so unadjusted rankings mislead.

title: Forecast accuracy track record
